correctness.rationale: Proof correctly treats a uniform labeled two-occurrence word; disjoint chord-label restrictions are independent. Independently enumerated ALL 2-,3-,4-,5-chord labeled words: totals 6,90,2520,113400 with event numerators 2,12,6,72,40,720, confirming probabilities 1/3,2/15,1/15,1/35,1/63,2/315. Classifying one- and two-label overlaps supplies the exact mixed moments for every n>=3. Separate enumeration of all 945 5-chord perfect matchings produced E(X)=10/3, E(T)=2/3, Var(X)=32/9, Var(T)=86/63, Cov=12/7; algebraic leading terms give 20/21. The finite 5-label census is exhaustive for the universal proof’s fixed local support, unlike mere finite-n tests.
